name: LLM Colosseum
description: Evaluates LLMs by having them compete against each other in Street Fighter III, a real-time fighting game. Models control game characters and make real-time decisions based on dynamic game states — opponent actions, health, and power. Assesses five dimensions: speed, intelligence, creativity, adaptability, and resilience, compiled into an ELO-based ranking across 546 documented fights.
evaluation_method: ELO ranking and win-rate matrices derived from head-to-head competitive gameplay
typical_sota_score: ELO-based; relative rankings vary by model generation
reputation: Hackathon project (Mistral Hackathon 2024, San Francisco); novel and unconventional real-time competitive evaluation; early-stage but notable for testing adaptive, low-latency decision-making
notes: Requires real-time API responses, heavily penalising latency. TextRobot uses text state descriptions; VisionRobot uses screenshots (multimodal). Results are highly dependent on API speed and pricing tier. Dataset small (546 fights). Not a standard community benchmark; primarily a proof-of-concept for game-based LLM evaluation.
